message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No confirmed new vulnerabilities were found for the deduplicated DLL software-component inventory during the last 24 hours.

**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only. `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-22 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-23 07:40 UTC (2026-10-22 13:10 IST through 2026-10-23 13:10 IST).

The scan covered the listed .NET/NuGet packages, JavaScript/npm libraries, document/PDF SDKs, identity and database components, and commercial vendor SDKs. GitHub's newest reviewed NuGet advisory was dated October 15, outside this window; its October 22 npm advisories did not match any listed component. CERT/CC's October 22 publication concerned PHP rather than a monitored component.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations and maintained libraries, MongoDB-owned notices, CVE/NVD records, GitHub Security Advisories, CISA sources, and credible security research. No MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported inside this exact window. The most recent item located, CVE-2026-113870 affecting MongoDB Compass, was dated October 21 and was excluded as out of scope.

### Sources checked

- [GitHub Advisory Database: NuGet, newest first](https://github.com/advisories?query=ecosystem%3Anuget+sort%3Apublished-desc)
- [GitHub Advisory Database: npm, newest first](https://github.com/advisories?query=ecosystem%3Anpm+sort%3Apublished-desc)
- [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)
- [CERT/CC Vulnerability Notes](https://www.kb.cert.org/vuls/)
- [CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog](https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog)

### Review priority

No immediate review is indicated by a newly reported, in-window issue. Continue normal monitoring; older known vulnerabilities and end-of-support risks were outside this scan's freshness scope.
